Xeoma video surveillance

Scalable video management for any need. Power thousands of cameras with AI analytics and face recognition across all platforms — all in one intuitive interface.

Learn more

Xeoma Cloud

Skip the hardware maintenance. Stream high-definition video directly to the cloud and monitor your property in real-time from any device.

Learn more

KnownCalls spam call blocker

Block unwanted calls and protect your family. Safeguard children and seniors from scammers with 100% on-device privacy.

Learn more

Xeoma Pro Your Cloud

Build your own cloud surveillance business. Use your hardware to sell cloud subscriptions and generate recurring revenue.
